articles.title: Trump signs sweeping Russia sanctions over Ukraine war - Al Jazeera
articles.description: New law allows tariffs of up to 100 percent on major buyers of Russian oil, including China and India.
articles.content: US President Donald Trump has signed into law a sweeping sanctions package targeting Russia over its war in Ukraine, days after Congress sent the bill to the White House with rare bipartisan support.… [+2259 chars]
